name: 獵火影忍者人
english_description: A Chinese-community MUD built on the same "Neolith 0.0.2" / ES2-lineage (Annihilator) engine framework already represented in this collection by huoying (a much earlier, near-empty snapshot of a plain "火影"/Naruto bootstrap: byte-identical master.lpc, identical adm/obj + daemon/{board,class,condition,misc,race,skill} + feature/{armor,char,npc,user,weapon} taxonomy, and the same originally-hardcoded MUD_PORT dispatch bug already documented in huoying's own NOTES.md) -- but this archive is the codebase's actual matured, actively-developed state: its own GitHub description self-identifies it as "Naruto X Hunter mud", the real login sequence displays two separate ANSI-art banners (one captioned "Hunter X Hunter", one captioned "火影忍者"), and its own in-game system announcement banner and uptime-counter text both literally brand the game "獵火影忍者人(NaHu)" -- a deliberate portmanteau of 獵人 (Hunter x Hunter) and 火影忍者 (Naruto). Unlike huoying's single placeholder wizard room, this snapshot ships a fully built-out ~20-domain world spanning both source anime's iconography (木叶/muye leaf-village imagery, 砂/sand_hole sand-village imagery, four_wheel_tower, god_forest, whale_island, etc.), a matching dual class/skill system (daemon/class/naruto/* ninjutsu classes alongside daemon/class/hxh/* Hunter-license classes, with Hunter x Hunter's six Nen categories -- 放出/操作/変化/特質/具現化/強化 -- implemented as real skill categories), and an extensive multi-wizard-authored u/ personal-build tree. Archive: 4,472 raw files (BIG5-encoded, correctly identified via the standard GB18030-vs-BIG5 mojibake check), 2,895 .lpc files after conversion. Porting fixes: the classic ES2/Neolith hardcoded-MUD_PORT connect() dispatch bug (silently rejected every connection until include/globals.h's MUD_PORT literal was updated to the assigned port, exactly as documented for huoying); the master.lpc log_error() lowercase-"warning"-vs-capitalized-"Warning" string check (identical to the zhyx/huoying-class bug -- every ordinary compile warning from every lazily-loaded file was being broadcast to the connected player as a garbled "！·#￥%……—*（" line, confirmed reproducing on every fresh registration before the fix and gone after); a genuinely corrupted historical save (data/chinese.o) with a stray backslash escaping past its own closing quote and swallowing the rest of the mapping literal, silently emptying the whole in-game English/Chinese translation dictionary on every boot; the identical stray-backslash-before-closing-quote typo independently repeated across 9 separate NPC/skill/item source files (a shared fire_sk.h combat-message string inherited by 10 four_wheel_tower NPCs, plus 8 further one-off instances), each a hard compile failure fixed by removing the errant backslash; a missing semicolon and a misplaced closing quote in two more personal-wizard files; an unguarded load_object(0) in logind.lpc's enter_world() (this driver throws "Bad argument 1 to find_object()" instead of MudOS's tolerant nil-coercion whenever a brand-new character's unset startroom/recoverroom property is passed straight through) guarded with stringp() checks; and a shared feature/save.lpc restore() left uncaught, letting a handful of old, genuinely-corrupted bulletin-board saves (real historical multi-line player post content, not reformatted) hard-abort their board's create() rather than degrading gracefully -- wrapped in catch() so a malformed save now safely returns 0 instead, verified live against two boards whose saves are still corrupted today (propose, bug) which now log cleanly instead of crashing. Confirmed making zero outbound network connections during boot or normal registration/gameplay -- the archive's adm/intermud/i2d.lpc Intermud-2 UDP service and adm/daemons/userid.lpc ident-lookup socket both exist and would dial out, but neither is preloaded nor reachable from any automatic boot/login code path (both real call sites in logind.lpc are commented out; only explicit wizard-only commands would trigger them). Booted clean on the real driver and verified end-to-end with real Chinese names: full registration (English id, Chinese display name, password, email, gender), landing in 巫師神殿 (Wizard's Temple, /world/area/wizard/guildhall), look/score/who/say/whoami/relogin all correct, admin (admin) status confirmed via a successful `update /adm/obj/master`, and a clean quit.
